item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: Exit code zero only proves the CLI process ended without reporting an OS-level failure; it does not prove the AI completed the requested task. A successful terminal event provides protocol-level confirmation that the run reached a valid completed state rather than exiting early, disconnecting, or silently stopping.
